item.text:
The audit now has 22 confirmed findings. This pass added:

- **Trim ignores the documented all-node decided requirement.** The leader accepted `trim(Some(1))` even though one node had accepted index 1 but still had decided index 0. The implementation gates on acceptance indexes rather than decided indexes: [audit_trim_decidedness.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_trim_decidedness.rs).
- **A second buffered reconfiguration returns false success.** While the first request remains unforwarded due to no leader, a second valid reconfiguration returns `Ok(())` but is silently discarded: [audit_pending_reconfigure.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_pending_reconfigure.rs).
- **An empty logging path panics during `build()`** instead of being rejected by validation: [audit_logger_path.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_logger_path.rs).

The captured implementation remains unchanged. Full findings, necessary conditions, code locations, reproduction commands, and retained outputs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
